notes.title: 1.0 Release!
notes.notes:
Upper Hand Launches into orbit this month! We are happy to announce that the 1.0 build of the game is finally completed, and that all worlds are playable. We have added many new abilities for you to try out as you progress through the game 

Thanks to everyone who has played our game and who have helped shape it along the way.  

Join Gen0 on his quest to escape earth!

notes.title: New Levels to Explore - Version .0031 Out now!
notes.notes:
][u][b]Patch Notes .0031[/b][/u]

[list]
[*] Our third world has arrived which includes more levels with unique challenges for you to unlock! Adapt to the new environment and obstacles to help Gen-0 escape
[*] Updated physics engine. See Gen-0 move in ways that weren’t possible before!
[*] New updated cards and effects, allowing you to have more freedom in how you approach each level
[*] Updated Evolve-a-pedia. Choose which upgrades you would like to pursue, the more challenges you complete the more you are able to unlock. Take a look at the clips within the Evolve-a-pedia to gain knowledge on the effects and help you better decide what you would like to unlock first!
[*] Quality of life updates
[*] Various Bug Fixes

If you have any feedback or suggestions of what you would like to see in our game please reach out to us on our socials or through our Steam page. Your feedback matters to us and we would love to know your thoughts!

notes.title: Version .0027 Out Now
notes.notes:
If you previously had a save prior to this update, you will have to delete the save to access the game. We are sorry for the inconvenience, our team is hard at work to ensure saves carry over in future updates!

[u][b]To Delete Save[/b][/u]

On title screen select [b]OPTIONS[/b]
Next select [b]DELETE SAVE[/b]

Once done you can begin enjoying The Upper Hand again. Now onto the rest of what this patch brings!

[u][b]Patch Notes .0027[/b][/u]

[list]
[*] Added multiple deck save slots
[*] Added new levels to unlock in a new world!
[*] Added achievements for all world 2 stages
[*] Added pause menu
[*] Added options menu in level select for quicker adjusting of volume
[*] Various Bug Fixes

If you have any feedback or suggestions of what you would like to see in our game please reach out to us on our socials or through our Steam page. Your feedback matters to us and we would love to know your thoughts!
